review.decision: Reuse the reviewed device selection cases and bind app container access to the selected UDID
review.notes: Extract the local target resolver from #1818. This review covers synthetic simctl inventory, real setup wiring under mocks and refusal before side effects. Source of the inventory, implicit target use, explicit override semantics and app container identity were checked against current main. Appium, WebDriverAgent, dependency locks, explicit device requirements for specialized suites, and supported runtimes retain their existing scope. This does not certify simulator boot, Appium execution, new runtimes, or native UI.

cases.description: Derive one real booted iOS device and runtime after 26.5 removal
cases.setup: One booted Duo27.2, unavailable legacy26.5; synthetic simctl inventory
cases.expected: Return the actual Duo UDID/name/27.2, never historical defaults
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Preserve explicit UDID, OS and hardware-name constraints
cases.setup: Available shutdown Duo and another booted iOS device
cases.action: Resolve explicit UDID plus equivalent27.2.0 version and Duo hardware type
cases.expected: Pin requested real device; preserve compatible explicit OS/name values
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Retain an explicitly requested older installed runtime
cases.action: Resolve26.5 by explicit real UDID/OS/device type
cases.expected: Use26.5 when genuinely available; migration is not a global support-policy change
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Fail a missing requested OS instead of silently upgrading
cases.expected: Throw before Appium; no substitute runtime
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Do not equate a Duo-like device name with Duo hardware
cases.action: Constrain hardware type to iPhone Duo
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Reject unknown or inconsistent explicit target identity
cases.action: Use missing/padded UDID or conflicting ordinary-phone type
cases.expected: Reject; container helpers and driver cannot receive inconsistent UDIDs
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Require a UDID for multiple booted devices
cases.setup: Two booted devices; optional name filter
cases.action: Resolve without then with explicit UDID
cases.expected: Default rejects ambiguity globally; exact UDID succeeds
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Do not select a random stored device by default
cases.setup: Available shutdown iOS device; no booted target
cases.expected: Reject with explicit boot/UDID guidance; no device creation
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Fail unavailable and duplicate device records
cases.setup: Synthetic unavailable or duplicate UDID records
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Use the resolved target for Appium and app container access
cases.setup: Mock simctl inventory and container lookup, WebDriver, process and filesystem boundaries; no native service
cases.action: Run global setup with one booted device and no explicit target
cases.expected: The same exact UDID is used by the simctl container lookup and WebDriver; runtime and name match the inventory, noReset is true, and implicit discovery leaves the explicit override unset
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness

cases.description: Reject ambiguous target before potentially destructive setup
cases.setup: Two booted devices; mock reclaim, app data, spawn and remote
cases.expected: Reject before reclaimBefore, writeDebugFlags, Appium spawn or remote connection
surfaces: iOS simulator / phone and iPad test harness
